narrative.overview:
Blue-black instrument panels make evidence the center of attention. Cool white type carries the dense reading; cyan identifies navigation and live monitoring. The user confirmed a professional dark technical aesthetic with subtle glow. Controls remain compact, explicit and close to the evidence they reveal.

This document covers only the Python-served browser dashboard, not the classic desktop. It records `assets/dashboard/index.html`, `dashboard.css` and `dashboard.js` as inspected on 7 November 2026. The dashboard surface brief owns page composition. Tokens here describe implementation, not rendered acceptance: the CUA host was unavailable, so screenshots and visual acceptance remain pending.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal surfaces with fine ruled boundaries.
Restrained live-state glow and a moving monitoring line.
Labeled acceptance states and evidence-first charts.
Compact typography with monospace revision identifiers.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Acceptance and implementation keep separate colors and explicit labels; color alone never establishes acceptance.

rules.name: The Quiet Instrument Rule
rules.body: Reserve glow for the live connection lamp; use tonal changes and borders to distinguish content and interaction.

dos: Do pair status color with a readable label or explicit count.
Do preserve unknown measurements and source links in every evidence view.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do review the rendered desktop and phone layouts before visual acceptance.
donts: Don't equate implementation blue with accepted mint.
Don't turn missing measurements into zero-valued benchmark bars.
Don't interpret timeline motion as delivery velocity.
Don't claim screenshots or rendered validation from source inspection.
